extraction.Name: Mary Cordier Red Owl
extraction.Sold/Mortgaged: I first mortgaged and then sold it.
extraction.Tax burden forced sale/Mortgage: I could not pay the taxes
extraction.NOTES: Received patent by mail at post office at Mission, South Dakota; did not remember exact date of delivery; did not sign a receipt; no debts settled at time of sale except the mortgage; wanted $4500 for land but could only get $2800; states 'I should like to get the land back'; has three children; states she is well; notarized April 8, 1929 by Jas. W. Cross, Notary Public, commission expires 4-28-32
